messages:
gemma: Quick sync — we have Snowflake + Pinecone validation next Tue. Need to lock marketplace listing checklist + co-announcement dependencies. who owns logos, SOC2 blurb, and embargo window? cc @alex @samir

alex: I can own the co-marketing PRD and draft the announcement copy. Need partner-approved one-liners and logos. ask partner for embargo date.

taylor: From ops side — we need a minimal sample notebook, a packaged connector (wheel), and an integration test that runs in CI. Samir, can eng deliver a demo by Mon EOD?

samir: Prototype exists. I will package wheel + notebook and drop to s3. uploading now:
``
aws s3 cp build/snowflake-pinecone-demo.zip s3://redwood-partner-demos/snowflake-pinecone-demo.zip
``
Link will be in the thread once uploaded. I can also add a tiny integration test that queries a 10-row table.

gemma: perfect — please include auth flow doc (oauth vs key). Partner wants a simple setup (no infra changes).

partner-pm: Partner here — logos and short product blurb attached in our drive. We can do a 2-week press lead, embargo ok. Can you confirm the marketplace listing requirements and if you need our legal to sign anything?

cheng: Legal — we'll need the co-marketing addendum signed. I can push partner MSA + co-release template. If they insist on an earlier embargo, flag it now. ETA EOD Wed for drafts.

alex: timeline check:
- Mon: eng demo + notebook
- Tue: internal validation (solutions + eng)
- Wed: legal + partner sign-off on blurb and logos
- Next Mon: publish marketplace listing + coordinate press (if embargo lifted)
Is that feasible?

taylor: Yes on timeline if eng delivers demo Monday. Ops will run the integration test Tuesday and share sandbox link.

marketplace-bot: [info] Draft listing created: https://marketplace.redwood.local/drafts/connector-1799991000 (visibility: private)

samir: Demo uploaded: s3://redwood-partner-demos/snowflake-pinecone-demo.zip — notebook at demos/notebook.ipynb. I'll also open ENG-789 to track the integration test and required CI creds.

gemma: action items (tracked):
- samir: upload demo + integration test (ENG-789)
- alex: draft announcement + gather partner one-liners/logo (PMM)
- cheng: circulate co-marketing template + MSA addendum
- taylor: run sandbox validation + share results
- partner-pm: confirm embargo date and sign addendum

alex: also please confirm whether the partner wants a verified connector badge; marketplace team requires a security checklist for that. cc @marketplace-bot

marketplace-bot: [task] Security checklist pending: dependency scanning, minimal RBAC doc, and container image policy. Use template: https://marketplace.redwood.local/checklists/security-connector.json

partner-pm: we can be flexible on badge. we'll expedite logo approvals this week.

gemma: great — I'll run a short demo session Thurs 9am PT with partners. invite incoming. thanks all.
